body:
Added mailaccounts.Client.AddEncryptionKey/GetEncryptionStatus and GET/POST /api/v1/mail/encryption on WebmailHandler. Verified against real production Stalwart: encryption cannot be enabled without a real OpenPGP/S-MIME key on file; adding one is the actual automatic trigger. Commits IDUNA_PRO f210969, CarePyre b732663.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-service mail encryption-at-rest (paste key -> auto-enable), verified live end to end
